_comment: Status for stories the citation scan cannot judge, read by scripts/build-progress-tracker.mjs.
Two cases: the platform build-out epics, whose ids (A-1, P-3, F-11) are too short to grep for
safely, and anything the scan gets wrong -- a story built before the convention of citing its
id existed, or one deliberately deferred. Every entry carries a note saying where the status
comes from; nothing here should be asserted without one.
Status must be one of: Done, In progress, Deferred, Superseded, Blocked, Not started.
